rule: K29: a (Manhwa) suffix limits MangaUpdates results to Manhwa

record.title: Bastard!!
record.description:
From Viz:  
In a post-apocalyptic world of heavy metal fantasy, the only thing able to save humans from orcs, lizard men, and other monsters is something even MORE evil. Sealed within a 14-year-old boy, the chaotic wizard Dark Schneider is unleashed to fight four mighty generals and their plot to resurrect the evil god Anthrasax.

Official Japanese:  
[Comico](https://www.comico.jp/magazine_comic/11030), [Mechacomic](https://mechacomic.jp/books/123042), [Piccoma](https://piccoma.com/web/product/7098?etype=episode), [Shonen Jump Plus](https://shonenjumpplus.com/episode/10833519556325021844), [Ultra Jump](https://ultra.shueisha.co.jp/manga/manga-907/), [Yangjiang+](https://ynjn.jp/title/1924), [Zebrack](https://zebrack-comic.shueisha.co.jp/title/141)

Note: Kazushi Hagiwara published numerous complementary dōjinshi for the series, [most being hentai](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=151931). Vol 1 & 2 of the Complete Edition feature redrawn art (mostly in Vol 2), additional scenes and two graphic sex scenes.

record.title: Asshole Hero
record.description:
Villains? How can there be villains in the world. They are all heroes!  
Li Erdan who only wants to be a villain, but he always does "good things" on accident and is repeatedly reported as a hero by the media. However just as when he was finally about to turn from evil to good, fate decides to play a joke on him.

**Original Manhua:**  
[AC.QQ](https://ac.qq.com/Comic/comicInfo/id/648609), [BiliBili](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc28478), [KuaiKan](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/7342/)

record.title: Bastard King
record.description:
Davon’s erratic behavior brings Lor to the breaking point once again. Scion wants to comfort him desperately, but the only comfort Lor will accept is in his bed. Can the demon god stick to his laurels even when his beloved Lor is in anguish? 

Now Davon wants to rule Ralstorm beside King Jereth. He has no problem getting ‘queen’ Moors out of the way. Aeon and Scion become the only two who can make things right. But they still haven’t figured out what’s wrong!

record.title: Bastard Swordsman
record.description: Although he was reincarnated into another world with some powerful abilities, the middle-aged guildman Mongrel had no great ambitions or noble aspirations. He didn't desire to rise to power, become invincible, or have a harem - he had only one dream: to live a peaceful, lazy life. He blended into the everyday life of the other world, working casually at the guild, cooking and fishing, and occasionally helping people.

record.title: Bought and Bound
record.description:
On the cold, lonely final night of the year, Sohee lies in her drafty rooftop room, wishing for an end to her endless suffering. Instead, an enigmatic man named Kye Wonho walks through her door with an unexpected claim: he’s bought out every last cent of her massive loan shark debt. Cold, ruthless, and terrifyingly efficient, Wonho leaves her with a chilling warning. Escape isn’t an option, because he always collects - even if it means selling a corpse.

**Original Novel**:   
[Chapters](https://ridibooks.com/books/5610000001), [Volumes](https://ridibooks.com/books/5610000166) 

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/3776003617)

**Official Translations:**    
[English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/bought_bound), [Japanese](https://mechacomic.jp/books/275679), [German](https://www.lezhinde.com/detail/dad_2000570), [French](https://www.lezhinfr.com/detail/daf_1001052)

record.title: Dirty Deeds
record.description:
When Sahui’s quiet life at Yeonghwadang, a secluded shaman house where she spent her whole life, is disrupted by imposing CEO Tae-eon Jeong, she wants nothing more than to keep her distance. Scarred by abandonment and a childhood accident, she has no interest in love. Yet Tae-eon’s arrogance, charm, and relentless attention begin to break through her defenses, stirring emotions she thought she had buried for good.

[Original Novel](https://m.series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=9234509)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=833620), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11769520)

**Official Translations:**     
[English](https://www.webtoons.com/en/romance/dirty-deeds/list?title_no=8808), [T.Chinese](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/romance-m/unraveled/list?title_no=7277), [French](https://www.webtoons.com/fr/romance/dirty-deeds/list?title_no=7918), [Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/dirty-deeds/list?title_no=7746), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0003802), [Spanish](https://www.webtoons.com/es/romance/dirty-deeds/list?title_no=10237), [Thai](https://www.webtoons.com/th/romance/crap/list?title_no=7291)

***Note:** English and Indonesian versions are censored.*

record.title: Ill-Mannered Disappearance
record.description:
When he was in high school, he met Lim Jae-ha, who was an unannounced man, and Yoo Kyung-ho, who happened to meet again.

Kyung-ho is uncomfortable with the reunion after 8 years, but even his ex-boyfriend finds out about the difference!

No matter how hard he tries to avoid Jae-ha, he keeps circling around and tormenting the guard... .

"What is it? It's pitiful, so I'm here to help."

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000051680), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10330887), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/ssagagi_disappearance)

record.title: The Mean Guy
record.description:
From Day Comics:  
SUNG-JO gets involved in a struggle for rights between mobs and hides out in a small town out in the country. "Why shouldn't I cause trouble here? No one here knows me anyway."

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/a_mean_fellow?p_id=pp_1601_001), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H045258883), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H045258883)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://global.toptoon.com/content/103311), [T.Chinese](https://www.toptoon.net/comic/epList/81089)

record.title: Weapon-Eating Bastard
record.description:
The peak of strength in South Korea is the Esteemed Martial Lee Clan. In that martial clan, Lee Cheol was looked down on and chased out because of his status as an illegitimate child.

In order to survive, he lived in shadows, but he was chased down and killed because of his family's schemes. He was then granted a second chance—regression.

Using his "ability to absorb the memories of a weapon" as a foundation, Lee Cheol would train and go down a path of struggle.

Persistent competition and schemes regarding the right to inheritance, attacks from other races and monsters in dangerous, unexplored lands, and even local clashes related to his family's internal struggles...

His growth would bring about these things, bringing hardship upon Lee Cheol.

Life itself would be a struggle for Lee Cheol, and this is his destiny.

But in order to protect himself and his surroundings—in order to protect everything—as the fight continues, he'll unravel secrets from his past life, one by one...!

**Original Webtoon:**     
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/66127705), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%AC%B4%EA%B8%B0-%EB%A8%B9%EB%8A%94-%EC%84%9C%EC%9E%90%EB%8B%98/4418)

**Official Translations:**      
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/182900)

record.title: BLADE & BASTARD
record.description:
From Yen Press:  
Who rules over the dungeon? The adventurers who plunder its riches or the fathomless foes that lurk in the gloom? When Crown Prince Festin visits Scale, he seeks to bring the adventurers to heel and assert the kingdom’s power over the dungeon. The prince soon meets Garbage, and though their statuses are polar opposites, the two bear a striking and uncanny physical resemblance. And then, the crown prince vanishes into the maw of the dungeon, signs point to him being kidnapped and dragged to the depths. Sezmar’s, Schumacher’s, and Iarumas’s parties are sent in to rescue the prince from the darkness. However, when the adventurers descend, they are greeted with the mocking laughter of a bizarre and powerful enemy. Who rules over that unknowable abyss? Perhaps the truth can only be found within the dungeon.

Set in the role-playing world of Wizardry.

[Official Japanese](https://drecomi-plus.jp/series/CD00007)

[Official B.Portuguese](https://br.comikey.com/comics/blade-bastard-manga/883/)
